newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ALPINVEST IN TOOTAL FABRICS BUY-OUT.
newsitem.headline: ALPINVEST IN TOOTAL FABRICS BUY-OUT.

text.p: A syndicate grouping Dutch venture capital firm Alpinvest, Halder Holdings and the management of Tootal Fabrics Holland has acquired all Tootal shares from its British parent, Alpinvest said on Thursday.
"Alpinvest and Halder have acquired stakes of 37.8 percent and 29.7 percent in this transaction," Alpinvest said.
It said Tootal Fabrics Holland previously formed part of Britain's TPT Group and Coats Viyella Plc.
No financial details of the buy-out were disclosed. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
